categories.counters: Counters of all kinds and ways to add/move/multiply them
categories.lands: Land drops, landfall, ramp by lands
categories.combat: Attacking, evasion, extra combats, keyword soup
categories.resources: Card draw, ramp, tutors, treasure, energy

proliferate.definition: Proliferate or other effects that add one of each counter already present.

counter_doubling.definition: Doubling or increasing the number of counters placed.

charge_counters.definition: Charge, lore, time and other resource counters on non-planeswalker permanents.

shield_counters.definition: Shield counters and similar protective counters.

player_counters.definition: Counters on players (poison, rad, experience, energy count separately).

infect.definition: Infect, toxic, poisonous and other ways to deal damage as poison.

poison_direct.definition: Giving poison counters without combat damage.

noncreature_tokens.definition: Treasure, Clue, Food, Blood, Map and other noncreature tokens.

token_doubling.definition: Doubling tokens or copying token creation.

go_wide.definition: Many creatures at once; anthems and mass pump.

self_mill.definition: Putting your own cards into your graveyard (mill, surveil, discard-to-fill).

reanimation.definition: Returning creatures from graveyard to battlefield.

recursion.definition: Returning cards from graveyard to hand or casting from graveyard.

graveyard_size.definition: Card counts or types in graveyard (threshold, delirium, descend).

sac_outlet.definition: Free or repeatable ways to sacrifice your own permanents.

death_trigger.definition: Value when creatures die (aristocrats payoffs, blood artist effects).

sac_fodder.definition: Permanents that are good to sacrifice (recurring, token-making, dies-value).

pay_life.definition: Using your own life total as a resource.

storm_count.definition: Many spells in one turn (storm, magecraft chains).

cast_from_exile.definition: Impulse draw, foretell, cascade, casting from exile.

lands_matter.definition: Land count, lands in graveyard, land recursion.

attack_triggers.definition: Things that happen when creatures attack.

combat_damage_triggers.definition: Things that happen when creatures deal combat damage to players.

goad.definition: Forcing opponents' creatures to attack others.

voltron.definition: Making one creature (usually the commander) huge and lethal.

shrink.definition: Temporary -X/-X effects ("gets -3/-3 until end of turn"), targeted or mass. Not counters - see minus1_counters.

protection.definition: Protecting your permanents (hexproof, indestructible, phasing, blink-to-save).

tutor.definition: Searching your library for specific cards.

blink.definition: Exiling and returning permanents to reuse ETBs.

toughness_matters.definition: Defenders, walls, assigning damage by toughness.

modified.definition: Modified creatures (counters, equipment, auras on them).

alt_wincon.definition: Winning or eliminating players outside normal damage.
